answer_1.quote: In this stage, we automatically construct unanswerable questions using a Question Generation (QG) model...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the models using the existing BLEU score metric ... we also propose a new metric called Unanswerable BLEU (UBLEU)...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 100 questions for each QG models, and ask four annotators to evaluate the questions quality using the same protocol as §3.2...
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator is asked to give a score to the generated questions with three criteria: Unanswerability, Relevancy, Fluency.
